SUPERSEDED: THIS DECLARATION IS SUPERSEDED AND ITS BAR WAS WITHDRAWN. It declares an r-based bar; r is a ratio of two sums and does not determine whether an overlay can pay -- on one book's own totals, varying only how adverse is distributed, r moves 18.63 -> 18.99% while the ceiling moves 0.00 -> 22.19%. v2 replaced the statistic with V_oracle; v3 replaced the scope (~40 coin-hours, not 138) and restated what that many cells license. Nothing below is edited -- this is a forward pointer only (rule 13).

WHAT_COUNTS_AS_REACHING_THE_THRESHOLD_de.closes_the_overlay_programme: fewer than 5% of coin-hours at or above 0.1988 on tail-excluded r, AND the 90th percentile below it — a distribution that never approaches the lower threshold
WHAT_COUNTS_AS_REACHING_THE_THRESHOLD_de.indeterminate: anything between; reported as indeterminate rather than argued either way
WHAT_COUNTS_AS_REACHING_THE_THRESHOLD_de.primary: the fraction of admissible coin-hours whose TAIL-EXCLUDED r is at or above each threshold
WHAT_COUNTS_AS_REACHING_THE_THRESHOLD_de.reaches_CONDVALUE: at least 25% of admissible coin-hours with tail-excluded r >= 0.2760
WHAT_COUNTS_AS_REACHING_THE_THRESHOLD_de.reaches_HAZARD: at least 25% of admissible coin-hours with tail-excluded r >= 0.1988
WHAT_COUNTS_AS_REACHING_THE_THRESHOLD_de.why_25_percent: a quarter of coin-hours is the weakest claim that could support 'this book sometimes clears the bar'; it is set now, before any histogram exists, and is not adjusted afterwards
WHAT_COUNTS_AS_REACHING_THE_THRESHOLD_de.why_tail_excluded_is_primary: r is a ratio of sums and inherits exactly the tail sensitivity that made the single-hour 18.63% misleading; a survey reporting only raw r reproduces the artefact it exists to escape

quantity: r = adverse / spread, per coin-hour, over the reference's kept tranches at zero cancels
tail_definition: top 1% of fills by absolute contribution, matching the fill-level decomposition R-523(B) used
the_measured_hour_is_one_cell: 2026-08-24 13:50-14:50Z btc appears as ONE CELL among the others and is NOT a reference point the others are compared against. If it is an outlier that is the finding.
touches_nothing_sealed: 09-01 and 09-02 are consumed economic reads and 09-03 is accrued and unopened; none is read
why_it_needs_no_replay: at zero cancels the baseline's fills ARE the reference's kept tranches, so r is a property of the BASELINE and not of any arm: no policy, no replay, no arm, no threshold
